nodes.title: 1x1 conv channel reshape
nodes.description: Convolution with kernel size 1; changes channel count without spatial mixing.

nodes.title: bulk-register lambdas with unbroadcast
nodes.description: For add/subtract/true_divide, the backwards are one-line lambdas: e.g. unbroadcast(g, x) for add-arg0, unbroadcast(-g, y) for sub-arg1, unbroadcast(g*(-x/y**2), y) for div-arg1.

nodes.title: reduce + broadcast
nodes.description: Compose all_reduce = reduce(dst=0) then broadcast(src=0); the simplest (non-ring) all-reduce algorithm.

nodes.title: sync accuracy across ranks
nodes.description: After per-rank eval, pack (total_correct, total_samples) into a tensor and all-reduce-sum so the final accuracy is over the whole test set.

nodes.title: average grads across ranks
nodes.description: After loss.backward() and before optimizer.step(), all-reduce each param.grad with op='mean' so every rank updates with the global gradient.

nodes.title: .any(dim=...) reduction
nodes.description: Reduce a boolean tensor by OR-along an axis; e.g. 'does any segment intersect this ray?' collapses an (nrays, nsegments) mask to (nrays,).

nodes.title: logprobs[arange(0, B), true_labels]
nodes.description: Canonical 'pick the correct class per row' idiom: a length-B aranged index along axis 0, plus the int label tensor along axis 1, gives a length-B vector of correct-class logprobs.

nodes.title: multiply_back0 vs multiply_back1
nodes.description: For multi-arg forwards, define one backward per positional input (_back0 for arg 0, _back1 for arg 1); not symmetric in general (e.g. division).

nodes.title: (logits.argmax(dim=1) == labels).sum()
nodes.description: Per-batch correct count for top-1 accuracy; sum across batches and divide by total samples.

nodes.title: as_strided overlap windows
nodes.description: Build sliding windows over a tensor with zero copy by reusing strides on a new shape.

nodes.title: avgpool over window
nodes.description: Mean-reduce each window (often global average pool at the end of a CNN).

nodes.title: back_fn(outgrad, node.array, *recipe.args, **recipe.kwargs)
nodes.description: The exact backward-call shape: outgrad first, then the cached out (= node.array), then the original raw-array args and kwargs from the Recipe.

nodes.title: iterate sorted graph, popping grads[node]
nodes.description: The main backprop loop: for each node in reverse-topo order, pop its accumulated outgrad from a grads dict; if leaf, set .grad; else, run each parent's backward fn and accumulate into grads[parent].

nodes.title: (grad_out, out, x, ...) -> grad_in
nodes.description: Every backward function takes grad_out (dL/d(out)), out (the forward output), and the original positional args of the forward fn; returns the gradient wrt one specific input. Canonical per-op rule signature.

nodes.title: dict keyed by (forward_fn, arg_position)
nodes.description: BackwardFuncLookup is essentially {(np.log, 0): log_back, (np.multiply, 0): multiply_back0, ...}; add_back_func / get_back_func are dict insert/lookup over that key.

nodes.title: fn(x, y).backward()
nodes.description: Compute gradients into .grad by calling .backward() on a scalar tensor returned by the loss function.

nodes.title: learnable scale and shift
nodes.description: Learnable gamma and beta applied after normalization.

nodes.title: running mean/var buffers
nodes.description: EMA-updated running mean and variance buffers; used in eval mode in place of batch statistics.

nodes.title: -log(D(x)).mean() - log(1-D(G(z))).mean()
nodes.description: Discriminator loss: maximize log(D(real)) + log(1-D(fake)) <-> minimize the negative. Manual log-form (not nn.BCELoss) because the labels are constant 1s and 0s. The defining minimax objective term.

nodes.title: m_hat = m / (1 - beta^t)
nodes.description: Divide first/second moment EMAs by 1 - beta^t so early-step estimates aren't biased toward zero (Adam/AdamW).

nodes.title: repeat N identical blocks
nodes.description: nn.Sequential of N blocks where only the first changes stride; the rest preserve shape.

nodes.title: BN weight ~ N(1, 0.02), bias = 0
nodes.description: BatchNorm layers get their multiplicative weight initialized around 1 (not 0, since BN multiplies), and the additive bias set to exactly zero. Always paired with dcgan-normal-init-002 in DCGAN init.

nodes.title: &, ~, | on bool tensors
nodes.description: Combine per-element predicates with bitwise ops; final mask is the AND of all geometric constraints (s>=0, u>=0, v>=0, u+v<=1, ~singular).

nodes.title: flatten -> Linear(hidden) -> Linear(latent)
nodes.description: End-of-encoder pattern: Rearrange('b c h w -> b (c h w)') then two Linears with ReLU between to project conv features down to the latent dimension. Mirror in decoder to expand back.

nodes.title: construct Tensor + attach Recipe
nodes.description: After running the numpy fn, wrap the result in a Tensor, set requires_grad, and (iff requires_grad) build Recipe(func, arg_arrays, kwargs, parents) and assign it to out.recipe.

nodes.title: sync model state from rank 0
nodes.description: After constructing the model independently on each rank, broadcast every param.data from rank 0 so all replicas start identical.

nodes.title: one-rank-sends-to-all
nodes.description: Implement broadcast by having the source rank loop dist.send to every other rank, while non-source ranks dist.recv from src and copy_ into the local tensor.

nodes.title: broadcast shape align
nodes.description: Right-align dims; size-1 dims stretch; mismatched non-1 dims error.

nodes.title: buf.copy_(new) for state
nodes.description: Update an EMA buffer via .copy_(...) so the buffer's underlying storage is overwritten; necessary because the buffer reference is shared with self.b.

nodes.title: dL/dx = grad_out * d(out)/dx
nodes.description: For an elementwise forward out = f(x), the backward is pointwise multiplication of grad_out with the local derivative; the Jacobian is diagonal so no sum/matmul required.

nodes.title: hidden_channels reversed for generator
nodes.description: Generator and discriminator share a hidden_channels list; discriminator builds in given order (innermost to outermost = chronological for downsampler), generator reverses it before iterating. 'Configure both halves from one list' pattern.

nodes.title: nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(params, max_norm)
nodes.description: Clip the global gradient norm of a parameter group to a max value, called between loss.backward() and optimizer.step(). Standard GAN-stability tool; clip_grad_norm: float | None = 1.0 is a default arg.

nodes.title: if not isinstance(y, Arr): y = np.array(y)
nodes.description: Backward functions for binary ops must coerce Python-scalar operands to ndarray so shape operations (unbroadcast, multiplication) don't blow up.

nodes.title: if mu != 0: ... shortcut
nodes.description: Skip the momentum/weight-decay block when the hyperparameter is zero; needed so momentum-less SGD behaves exactly like vanilla gradient descent in tests.

nodes.title: row-major storage
nodes.description: Tensors stored in contiguous row-major memory; .stride() returns per-dim element offsets.

nodes.title: sum over in_channels
nodes.description: Einsum reduces the in-channel dimension into the out-channel dimension via the kernel.

nodes.title: conv kernel layout
nodes.description: Weight tensor shape (out_channels, in_channels, kernel_dims...); 1D=(oc,ic,kw), 2D=(oc,ic,kh,kw).

nodes.title: Conv -> (BN) -> LeakyReLU
nodes.description: Canonical DCGAN discriminator block: stride-2 conv to halve spatial size, BatchNorm (skipped on first layer), LeakyReLU(0.2) as the activation. The downsampling mirror of the generator block.

nodes.title: output-shape formula
nodes.description: out = (W - K + 2P) / S + 1 with floor division.

nodes.title: zero-padding edges
nodes.description: Append and prepend zeros around spatial dimensions before windowing.

nodes.title: stride > 1 downsample
nodes.description: Stride greater than 1 reduces spatial output dim by that factor.

nodes.title: 1D conv via windowed einsum
nodes.description: as_strided to slide a 1D kernel window, einsum to contract kernel with window.

nodes.title: 2D conv via windowed einsum
nodes.description: Same as 1D but with two spatial dimensions.

nodes.title: pad(k-1) + flip kernel -> conv
nodes.description: Core identity: a transposed convolution (no stride, no padding) equals a regular convolution with (k-1) zero-padding on each side AND the kernel flipped along its spatial axes. The mathematical key that lets you implement convT in terms of conv.

nodes.title: sf = 1/sqrt(out * kH * kW); Unif[-sf, sf]
nodes.description: PyTorch's ConvTranspose2d weight init: uniform [-sqrt(k), sqrt(k)] with k = 1 / (out_channels * kernel_h * kernel_w). Note the denominator uses out_channels, mirroring the fan-out convention (vs Linear's fan-in).

nodes.title: rearrange 'i o k -> o i k'
nodes.description: Transposed-conv kernels store channels as (in, out, kernel...) (opposite of conv's (out, in, kernel...)); conversion to a conv-compatible kernel is an einops rearrange swapping the first two axes, applied after the spatial flip.

nodes.title: ConvT -> BatchNorm -> ReLU/Tanh
nodes.description: Canonical generator block: doubles spatial size, normalizes, applies activation. Tanh (not ReLU) on the very last block so output is in [-1, 1] matching Normalize((0.5,...), (0.5,...)) preprocessing.

nodes.title: F.cross_entropy(logits, labels)
nodes.description: The standard supervised-classification loss (combines log-softmax + NLL); takes raw logits, not probabilities.

nodes.title: t.cuda.empty_cache()
nodes.description: Release cached GPU allocator memory between frames in a long render loop to avoid OOM.

nodes.title: raise on revisit in temp
nodes.description: During DFS, if you reach a node already in the temp set, the graph has a cycle; raise. Distinguishes 'already done' (perm, return) from 'found cycle' (temp, raise).

nodes.title: @dataclass Args object
nodes.description: Bundle all training hyperparameters (lr, batch_size, epochs, wandb names) into a single @dataclass so the trainer's signature stays flat.

nodes.title: replace(args, **sampled)
nodes.description: Use dataclasses.replace to clone the args dataclass with multiple fields overridden in one expression; cleaner alternative to per-field assignment in wandb sweep update_args.

nodes.title: DataLoader batch and shuffle
nodes.description: torch.utils.data.DataLoader wraps a Dataset with batching, shuffling, and parallel loading.

nodes.title: num_workers + pin_memory DataLoader
nodes.description: Configure DataLoader for GPU efficiency: parallel workers prefetch batches, pinned memory enables async host-to-device copies; the standard ResNet-on-CIFAR throughput pattern.

nodes.title: nn.init.normal_(w, 0.0, 0.02)
nodes.description: Per the DCGAN paper, init all Conv / ConvTranspose / Linear weights from N(0, 0.02). The 'magic number' init that makes DCGANs converge.

nodes.title: DCGAN(nn.Module) with .netG / .netD
nodes.description: Thin wrapper module that holds both generator (self.netG) and discriminator (self.netD) as submodules but has no forward() — callers invoke model.netG(...) and model.netD(...) directly. The 2-network-in-one-Module idiom.

nodes.title: xy.detach().clone() per step
nodes.description: Record an inert copy of the parameter at each step so the trajectory list isn't a list of aliases to the live (in-place-updated) tensor.

nodes.title: img_fake.detach() into discriminator
nodes.description: When training the discriminator on fake images, pass img_fake.detach() so backprop through the loss only updates D, not G. Without detach the generator would receive an update from D's own gradient step, which is wrong. The single most-recognizable GAN-training idiom.

nodes.title: construct tensors on same device
nodes.description: Helper tensors built inside a GPU computation (e.g. t.eye(3)) must be .to(device) to match operands; mismatched devices raise.

nodes.title: perm / temp / result DFS pattern
nodes.description: Classic depth-first topological sort: perm set = fully done, temp set = currently in DFS stack (cycle detector), result list = post-order append. Visit children before appending self.

nodes.title: diagonal via stride-sum
nodes.description: 1D walk with stride equal to (row_stride + col_stride) reads the diagonal.

nodes.title: flatten -> Linear(1) -> Sigmoid
nodes.description: End-of-discriminator: Rearrange('b c h w -> b (c h w)'), Linear(final_size, 1, bias=False), Sigmoid(). Produces a per-image real/fake probability scalar.

nodes.title: BACK_FUNCS.get_back_func(node.recipe.func, argnum)
nodes.description: Inside the backprop loop, look up the correct backward fn by (the node's forward func, the parent's argnum); the moment the lookup table earns its keep.

nodes.title: dist.send / dist.recv
nodes.description: Point-to-point primitives: each send(dst=k) on one rank must be matched by a recv(src=k') on rank k; the building blocks of all collectives.

nodes.title: DistributedSampler(ds, num_replicas, rank)
nodes.description: Shard a dataset across ranks so each process sees a disjoint slice each epoch; remember to call set_epoch(epoch) to reshuffle.

nodes.title: (y z) flatten / unflatten
nodes.description: rearrange('... (y z) -> ... y z', y=Y) folds or unfolds a product axis into two named axes; replaces .view/.reshape with self-documenting syntax.

nodes.title: einops.reduce with min/max/mean
nodes.description: Reduce along a named axis with a chosen reduction op; here used to take the min distance over the NT (triangles) axis.

nodes.title: einops.repeat for outer product
nodes.description: repeat('a p d -> a b p d', b=N) inserts a new broadcast dim; the canonical pair-every-with-every pattern for batched intersection tests.

nodes.title: einsum / einops.einsum
nodes.description: Label-string contraction over named dimensions; replaces nested loops with a declarative spec.

nodes.title: loss = recon_loss + beta_kl * kl_loss
nodes.description: Total VAE loss is reconstruction + a beta-weighted KL term. beta_kl is a scalar hparam; tuning it trades reconstruction sharpness vs latent-space regularity.

nodes.title: m <- beta1*m + (1-beta1)*g
nodes.description: Exponentially weighted moving average of gradients (Adam/AdamW first moment); distinct from momentum because of the (1-beta1) factor that caps terminal velocity.

nodes.title: v <- beta2*v + (1-beta2)*g^2
nodes.description: EMA of squared gradients (RMSprop's v, Adam/AdamW's v); used to scale per-coordinate learning rate.

nodes.title: mirrored conv / transposed-conv stack
nodes.description: Autoencoder/VAE/GAN-generator pattern: encoder downsamples via Conv2d(stride=2), decoder mirrors via ConvTranspose2d(stride=2) with same channel counts in reverse. The defining structural symmetry of every reconstruction/generation model.

nodes.title: ones_like(end_node.array) if end_grad is None
nodes.description: When no end_grad is supplied, use ones_like(end_node.array); equivalent to backpropagating from L = end_node.sum(). The directional-derivative default.

nodes.title: examples_seen += imgs.shape[0]
nodes.description: Maintain an integer counter of training examples processed, use it as step= for wandb.log instead of the iteration count.

nodes.title: dL/dx = out * grad_out
nodes.description: Derivative of np.exp; uses out (the precomputed exp(x)) directly. Canonical 'use out, not x' example.

nodes.title: insert (s-1) zeros between input elements
nodes.description: Stride-s transposed conv = insert (s-1) zeros between every pair of adjacent input elements, THEN do a stride-1 transposed conv. Implemented by allocating a zeros tensor of the spaced shape, then x_new[..., ::s] = x. The 'fractional stride' that turns convT into an upsampler.

nodes.title: freeze params
nodes.description: Set requires_grad = False on a subset of parameters to exclude them from optimization.

nodes.title: Module wraps F.* op
nodes.description: Module is a parameter container; forward delegates to torch.nn.functional.* with self.weight as kernel; pattern for Conv2d, BatchNorm2d, MaxPool2d wrappers.

nodes.title: -log(D(G(z))).mean()
nodes.description: Generator loss: maximize log(D(G(z))) <-> minimize the negative. NOT -log(1-D(G(z))) (the symmetric form) — the standard 'non-saturating' trick to give the generator stronger gradients early in training.

nodes.title: latent_dim -> (C, H0, W0) via Linear + Rearrange
nodes.description: First layer of DCGAN generator: Linear(latent_dim, C*H0*W0, bias=False) followed by Rearrange('b (c h w) -> b c h w'), BatchNorm2d, ReLU. Transforms 1D latent into a small feature map ready for transposed convs.

nodes.title: toposort takes get_children fn
nodes.description: Decouple the toposort from the node type by passing get_children: Callable[[Node], list[Node]] as a parameter; lets the same fn work for Node (tests) and Tensor (real).

nodes.title: np.add.at(zeros_like(x), index, grad_out)
nodes.description: Derivative of indexing x[index]: scatter grad_out into a zero tensor at the indexed positions, using np.add.at so repeated indices accumulate (not overwrite).

nodes.title: node.grad = grad_in if grad is None else grad + grad_in
nodes.description: During backprop, leaf gradients accumulate (not overwrite) so multiple paths from L to the same leaf all contribute; implemented as 'create on first hit, else add'.

nodes.title: derivative via out, not x
nodes.description: Sometimes the local derivative is computationally cheaper expressed via out (e.g. d(exp)/dx = out); the reason backward fn signatures include both out and x.

nodes.title: grad_tracking_enabled module-level bool
nodes.description: A process-wide flag (set/reset by NoGrad context manager); when False, no recipe is created and requires_grad is forced False. Equivalent of torch.no_grad().

nodes.title: grads[parent] = in_grad if new else grads[parent] + in_grad
nodes.description: Inside the backprop loop, accumulate per-parent gradient contributions in a dict[Tensor, Arr] keyed by tensor identity; multiple paths sum here.

nodes.title: dict-of-class-to-image, then stack
nodes.description: Construct a fixed HOLDOUT_DATA tensor of shape (10, 1, 28, 28) by iterating the test loader and keeping one example per MNIST class. Used to monitor reconstruction quality across all digit classes during training.

nodes.title: group > kwarg > default
nodes.description: Resolve a per-group hyperparameter by dict-merging defaults, kwargs, and the group dict in priority order ({**defaults, **kwargs, **group}).

nodes.title: tensor[mask] = float('inf')
nodes.description: Overwrite non-hit entries with +/-inf so a subsequent min/max reduction naturally skips them without a separate masked-reduce.

nodes.title: @t.inference_mode() on step
nodes.description: Decorate the optimizer's step method so its tensor ops don't build an autograd graph (similar to no_grad but cheaper).

nodes.title: dist.init_process_group('nccl', rank, world_size)
nodes.description: Mandatory per-process setup that registers the rank in the NCCL communicator; must be paired with destroy_process_group() at the end.

nodes.title: in-place mutation breaks recorded args
nodes.description: Running add_ after a forward whose Recipe captured the pre-mutation array yields wrong gradients; torch raises, custom impl just warns. Why we generally avoid in-place during backprop.

nodes.title: theta -= lr * g in-place
nodes.description: Mutating the parameter tensor in place is required; reassigning would unhook it from the autograd graph and from the optimizer's view of self.params.

nodes.title: wrap_forward_fn(fn, is_differentiable=False)
nodes.description: For argmax/equal etc., still wrap so unboxing/boxing happens, but skip Recipe construction entirely; output requires_grad is always False.

nodes.title: Kaiming uniform init
nodes.description: Sample uniformly with bound +/-1/sqrt(fan_in); the default init pattern for Linear/Conv weight and bias.

nodes.title: sf = in_features**-0.5; rand in [-sf, sf]
nodes.description: Linear weight init: scale uniform [-sf, sf] with sf = 1/sqrt(in_features) (fan-in Kaiming/He uniform); same scheme for bias.

nodes.title: 0.5 * (mu^2 + exp(2*logsigma) - 1) - logsigma
nodes.description: Analytic KL between N(mu, sigma^2) and N(0, 1), per-element. Mean over batch to get the loss term. The 'regularize latents toward standard normal' half of the VAE objective.

nodes.title: forward kwargs stored on Recipe, replayed in back fn
nodes.description: Kwargs (e.g. dim, keepdim, axes, new_shape) must be forwarded both to numpy_func AND stored on the Recipe so backward fns can read them with the same names. The sum_back(dim=..., keepdim=...) failure mode.

nodes.title: is_leaf = recipe is None and requires_grad
nodes.description: Leaf tensors are user-created tensors (no recipe) that the user wants gradients on; they accumulate .grad rather than just propagating it.

nodes.title: t.linalg.solve with batch dims
nodes.description: Solve Ax = b; accepts arbitrary leading batch dims on A (...nn) and b (...n), so per-ray-per-triangle solves run as a single call.

nodes.title: x @ self.weight.T + self.bias
nodes.description: The forward of the custom Linear: matmul against a transposed weight, optionally add a 1-D bias. Identical math to torch.nn.Linear but uses the custom @ and .T ops.

nodes.title: t.linspace with out=
nodes.description: Write a 1D ramp directly into a view of an existing tensor via the out= kwarg, avoiding an intermediate allocation.

nodes.title: dL/dx = grad_out / x
nodes.description: Derivative of np.log; elementwise division of grad_out by the input. The canonical first backward rule.

nodes.title: @t.inference_mode() log_samples(self)
nodes.description: Trainer method that runs the model in inference mode on holdout data (or generates from random noise for GANs), normalizes output to uint8, and logs as wandb.Image(...). Called every args.log_every_n_steps. The 'watch your model train' hook.

nodes.title: logprobs = logits - logsumexp(logits, dim=-1)
nodes.description: Cross-entropy via the log-softmax identity: logprobs[i,j] = logits[i,j] - log(sum(exp(logits[i,:]))), then negate the indexed correct-label logprobs.

nodes.title: loss.item() for logging
nodes.description: Call .item() on a 0-dim loss tensor to get a Python float before passing it to wandb.log or an f-string; required because tensors can't be JSON-serialized.

nodes.title: hand-write forward+backward chain w/o autograd
nodes.description: Warm-up exercise: implement a small computational graph (e.g. g = log(d*log(c) * (a*b))) and propagate grads using only per-op _back functions, manually plumbing grad_out along each edge.

nodes.title: matrix-matrix mult
nodes.description: Standard 2D matmul; contract last axis of A with first axis of B.

nodes.title: grad_out @ y.T, x.T @ grad_out
nodes.description: Derivative of 2D x @ y; gradient wrt x is grad_out @ y.T, gradient wrt y is x.T @ grad_out. The defining identity of matmul backprop.

nodes.title: matrix-vector mult
nodes.description: Special-case matmul; contract last axis of matrix with vector.

nodes.title: (x > y) + 0.5*(x == y) mask
nodes.description: Derivative of np.maximum; 1 where this arg strictly wins, 0.5 on ties (PyTorch convention), then multiply by grad_out and unbroadcast.

nodes.title: maxpool over window
nodes.description: Max-reduce each window of a strided view.

nodes.title: t.save(model.state_dict(), path)
nodes.description: Persist a trained model's parameters at the end of training; called from rank 0 only in DDP runs because all replicas hold identical state.

nodes.title: hand-rolled Module with __call__ = forward
nodes.description: Minimal substitute for nn.Module over the custom Tensor: stores child modules/params as attributes, implements parameters() recursion and extra_repr.

nodes.title: sub-module registration
nodes.description: Assigning child nn.Module instances as attributes auto-registers them as sub-modules.

nodes.title: extra_repr override
nodes.description: Override extra_repr on nn.Module to customize the printed representation.

nodes.title: for m in model.modules(): isinstance(m, ...)
nodes.description: Walk the full module tree with .modules(), then dispatch initialization (or any per-type op) using isinstance(m, (Conv2d, Linear, ...)). The canonical 'do something to every layer of a specific type' idiom.

nodes.title: b <- mu*b + g
nodes.description: Classical SGD momentum: running sum of gradients with leak factor mu, then use b as the effective gradient.

nodes.title: mp.spawn(fn, args, nprocs)
nodes.description: Launch nprocs worker processes, each running fn(rank, *args); the canonical entry point for a single-node multi-GPU job.

nodes.title: nn.MSELoss()(img, img_reconstructed)
nodes.description: Standard pixel-wise L2 loss between an input and its reconstruction; used in autoencoder and VAE training. Applied to raw tensors, no per-pixel reduction kwargs needed.

nodes.title: encoder outputs (mu, logsigma) pair
nodes.description: Replace single-vector encoder output with TWO vectors of size latent_dim: mean mu and log std logsigma. Implemented by doubling the final Linear out_features then Rearrange('b (n d) -> n b d', n=2).

nodes.title: dL/dx = unbroadcast(y * grad_out, x)
nodes.description: Derivative of elementwise x*y wrt x; multiply by the other operand then unbroadcast back to original shape.

nodes.title: dL/dx = -grad_out
nodes.description: Derivative of np.negative; trivial sign flip of grad_out.

nodes.title: double-loop over groups+params
nodes.description: Both step and zero_grad get an outer loop over self.param_groups and an inner loop over each group's params, using group-specific hparams.

nodes.title: nn.Module subclass
nodes.description: Inherit nn.Module, override __init__ and forward, call super().__init__().

nodes.title: nn.Parameter wrap
nodes.description: Wrap learnable tensors in nn.Parameter so .parameters() finds them and the optimizer updates them.

nodes.title: with NoGrad(): p -= ... during optimizer step
nodes.description: Parameter updates use the custom NoGrad context manager to flip grad_tracking_enabled off temporarily; analogous to torch.no_grad() around optimizer.step().

nodes.title: last decoder/generator layer is bare
nodes.description: The very last ConvTranspose2d (or Linear) in a decoder/generator has no ReLU/activation after it; the model needs freedom to produce any output value, not just non-negative ones. Common gotcha when copy-pasting block patterns.

nodes.title: t.randn(batch, latent_dim).to(device)
nodes.description: Fresh random latent batch per training iteration: shape (batch_size, latent_dim_size), on device, NOT inside the model. Feeds the generator to produce a new fake batch each step.

nodes.title: argmax/eq via wrap_forward_fn(is_differentiable=False)
nodes.description: Non-differentiable ops still need wrapping (so unboxing works), but their outputs always have requires_grad=False and recipe=None.

nodes.title: optimizer_class(**kwargs)
nodes.description: Accept the optimizer constructor and a hparam dict as arguments, so different optimizers can be swapped without rewriting the loop.

nodes.title: params as list, not generator
nodes.description: self.params = list(params) in optimizer __init__; turns the iterable into a list so iterating it later (in step) doesn't exhaust a generator.

nodes.title: optim over a non-model tensor
nodes.description: Pass (xy,) to an optimizer to do gradient descent on a single tensor that represents (x, y) coordinates, not model parameters.

nodes.title: __repr__ hparam summary
nodes.description: Every optimizer implementation defines __repr__ returning a string like 'SGD(lr=..., momentum=..., weight_decay=...)'; used in test output and tqdm postfix.

nodes.title: per-param zeros_like buffers
nodes.description: Allocate one state tensor per parameter at init time (self.b = [t.zeros_like(p) for p in self.params]); the canonical per-parameter EMA-buffer pattern.

nodes.title: pad_actual = k - 1 - padding
nodes.description: The padding kwarg on conv_transpose SUBTRACTS from the implicit (k-1) zero-padding (rather than adding to it like in regular conv). The non-obvious sign-flip that trips everyone up.

nodes.title: read theta.grad
nodes.description: Every optimizer step reads the gradient tensor PyTorch has populated on each parameter via .grad.

nodes.title: [{'params':..., 'lr':...}] input
nodes.description: Parameters can be passed as a list of dicts so different subsets get different hyperparameters (e.g. higher lr on the head).

nodes.title: Parameter(Tensor) w/ requires_grad=True
nodes.description: A Parameter is a custom Tensor subclass flagged as learnable; Module.parameters() walks fields and yields the Parameters so the optimizer can update them.

nodes.title: Parameter(Tensor(...)) two-step wrap
nodes.description: Weights & biases are created as Parameter(Tensor(np.random...)) so they're (a) ndarray-backed, (b) Tensor-wrapped, (c) Parameter-flagged.

nodes.title: dispatch on input shape
nodes.description: Branch in __init__ based on whether params is a flat iterable or already a list of group dicts; wrap the flat case as [{'params': params}].

nodes.title: {argnum: parent_tensor} for Tensor inputs only
nodes.description: Recipe.parents is a dict keyed by positional-arg-index, holding ONLY the Tensor inputs (skip ints/floats); lets backprop walk the right edges and dispatch the right _backN function.

nodes.title: t.device(f'cuda:{rank}')
nodes.description: Each rank pins itself to one GPU by index = rank; model and tensors must be moved to this device.

nodes.title: np.transpose(grad_out, np.argsort(axes))
nodes.description: Derivative of np.transpose with permutation axes; invert the permutation via np.argsort(axes), then re-transpose grad_out.

nodes.title: LaTeX greek to tensor ops
nodes.description: Mechanical translation from indexed pseudocode (b_t <- mu*b_{t-1} + g_t) into Python tensor ops using running buffers; the core skill of all four optimizer-impl exercises (SGD/RMSprop/Adam/AdamW).

nodes.title: t.randn_like(sigma) for matched-shape noise
nodes.description: Generate standard-normal noise with the same shape, dtype, and device as an existing tensor; the canonical 'where do I get eps from' answer in VAE reparam + GAN-generator latent sampling.

nodes.title: per-rank function signature
nodes.description: Every distributed function takes (rank, world_size, ...) so each spawned process knows its index and the total count.

nodes.title: if rank == 0: wandb.log(...)
nodes.description: Guard wandb/print/save calls so only one rank performs them, preventing duplicate runs/files.

nodes.title: R(u) = O + uD
nodes.description: A ray is (origin, direction); points on it are O + uD for u >= 0. The fundamental representation that every ray-tracing exercise builds on.

nodes.title: einops.layers.torch.Rearrange in nn.Sequential
nodes.description: Use Rearrange('b c h w -> b (c h w)') (and inverse) as a stateless module inside nn.Sequential so flatten/unflatten lives in the module list rather than forward(). The canonical idiom for keeping forward() trivial.

nodes.title: Recipe(func, args, kwargs, parents)
nodes.description: A @dataclass capturing exactly the data needed to run the backward pass for one node: the forward fn, its raw-array args, kwargs, and a {arg_idx: parent_tensor} dict.

nodes.title: all-send-then-dst-accumulates
nodes.description: Implement reduce by having every non-dst rank dist.send, while dst loops dist.recv into a fresh buffer and accumulates into the local tensor.

nodes.title: tensor /= world_size
nodes.description: Implement op='mean' by reducing-sum then dividing by world_size in place; equivalent to averaging across processes.

nodes.title: add_back_func(np.fn, argpos, back_fn) per new op
nodes.description: Adding a new differentiable op: (a) wrap its forward with wrap_forward_fn, (b) register one _back per differentiable arg position. The 2-step 'extend the framework' idiom.

nodes.title: register_buffer for non-learnable state
nodes.description: Use self.register_buffer(name, tensor) for state that participates in state_dict but not in optimization (running stats, attention masks, position encodings).

nodes.title: ReLU = max(x, 0)
nodes.description: Per-element max with zero; the canonical nonlinear activation.

nodes.title: z = mu + sigma * randn_like(sigma)
nodes.description: Sample latents in a way that keeps gradients flowing: draw eps ~ N(0,1), then z = mu + exp(logsigma) * eps. eps is non-learnable so backprop sees z as a deterministic function of (mu, logsigma). The single defining trick of VAEs.

nodes.title: swap classifier head
nodes.description: Replace the last Linear layer with a new one matching the target num_classes.

nodes.title: assert xy.requires_grad
nodes.description: Sanity-check before optimizing: a leaf tensor must have requires_grad=True or .backward() and .step() will silently do nothing.

nodes.title: OR over input flags & global toggle
nodes.description: out.requires_grad = grad_tracking_enabled AND is_differentiable AND any(input.requires_grad for input in args). A tensor needs grad iff tracking is on, the op is differentiable, AND at least one input needs grad.

nodes.title: np.reshape(grad_out, x.shape)
nodes.description: Derivative of np.reshape; reshape the incoming gradient back to the original input shape (the inverse reshape).

nodes.title: identity skip connection
nodes.description: output = F(x) + (shortcut(x) or x); the ResNet defining feature.

nodes.title: initial conv+bn+relu+maxpool
nodes.description: Standard ResNet input pattern: 7x7 conv stride 2, batchnorm, ReLU, 3x3 maxpool stride 2.

nodes.title: __rmul__ for 2 * tensor to dispatch correctly
nodes.description: The Tensor class needs both __mul__ and __rmul__ so 2 * t (where Python first asks int.__mul__) falls through to the Tensor's reverse op.

nodes.title: hand-built rotation about axis
nodes.description: Construct R_y(theta) (or R_x, R_z) from cos/sin of a scalar tensor; apply by points @ R.

nodes.title: solve 2x2 ray-vs-segment
nodes.description: Set O + uD = L1 + v(L2-L1), stack [D, L1-L2] as columns, solve a 2x2 system; intersection iff u >= 0 and 0 <= v <= 1.

nodes.title: with NoGrad(): for p in params: p -= p.grad * lr
nodes.description: Minimal SGD on the custom Tensor: zero_grad sets all p.grad = None, step subtracts p.grad * lr in place under NoGrad() to keep the update off the autograd graph.

nodes.title: replace singular with identity
nodes.description: Compute det, mark |det| < eps as singular, set mat[is_singular] = t.eye(n) so batched solve doesn't throw, then AND-out singular results at the end.

nodes.title: slice = write-back view
nodes.description: Basic indexing like tensor[:, 1, 1] returns a view sharing storage; assigning into it mutates the original tensor.

nodes.title: reverse-topo from end_node via recipe.parents
nodes.description: topological_sort(end_node, get_parents)[::-1] where get_parents(t) = list(t.recipe.parents.values()) returns Tensors in execution-friendly order (root first, leaves last).

nodes.title: g / (sqrt(v) + eps)
nodes.description: Per-coordinate adaptive scaling with an eps floor under the sqrt to avoid divide-by-zero (RMSprop/Adam denominator).

nodes.title: t.stack vs t.cat
nodes.description: stack introduces a new dim, cat joins along an existing one; choose stack when assembling vectors as columns or rows of a new matrix.

nodes.title: load pretrained weights
nodes.description: Use load_state_dict to copy weights from another module; handles key renaming between custom modules and torchvision.

nodes.title: self.t += 1 for bias correction
nodes.description: Track a Python int step counter so Adam/AdamW can compute 1 - beta**t bias correction; must be incremented after each update.

nodes.title: stride=0 repeat trick
nodes.description: Stride 0 along a dimension causes that dim to repeat the same memory; no-copy broadcast.

nodes.title: sum is the dual of broadcast
nodes.description: Broadcasting in forward = summing in backward, and vice versa; the unifying intuition for both unbroadcast (multiply/add/max backwards) and sum_back (sum backward).

nodes.title: expand_dims then broadcast_to(x.shape)
nodes.description: Derivative of np.sum with dim/keepdim; if keepdim=False re-insert summed dims with np.expand_dims, then broadcast_to original shape.

nodes.title: wandb.sweep + wandb.agent
nodes.description: Register a sweep config (gets a sweep_id), then run an agent that calls a no-arg train() function N times.

nodes.title: dict(method, metric, parameters)
nodes.description: Declarative wandb-sweep config: search method (random/bayes/grid), metric to optimize, and a distribution per hyperparameter.

nodes.title: log_uniform_values / values
nodes.description: Per-hparam distribution spec: min/max + distribution for continuous, values=[...] for categorical.

nodes.title: t.stack(xy_list)
nodes.description: Concatenate the per-step snapshot tensors into a single (n+1, 2) trajectory tensor for plotting.

nodes.title: reshape / view / flatten
nodes.description: Rearrange dimensions without copy when contiguous; view requires contiguity, reshape may copy.

nodes.title: .to('cuda') / .cpu()
nodes.description: Move a tensor between devices; returns a new tensor that must be reassigned. .cuda()/.cpu() are shorthand.

nodes.title: Tensor(array, requires_grad, recipe, grad)
nodes.description: The custom Tensor wrapper class holds a np.ndarray plus four fields: requires_grad, recipe, grad, is_leaf. The graph-building shell around raw numpy.

nodes.title: preallocate with t.zeros
nodes.description: Allocate an output tensor with t.zeros(shape, dtype=...), then fill via slice-assignment; the canonical 'write-into-a-buffer' pattern.

nodes.title: time.time() per training phase
nodes.description: Instrument each phase of the distributed training step with time.time() deltas and log per-phase durations (fwd_time, bwd_time, dist_time) to wandb; the standard 'is my GPU saturated, is all_reduce the bottleneck?' debugging pattern.

nodes.title: top-k logits to labels
nodes.description: torch.topk on output logits to produce ranked class predictions.

nodes.title: pbar.set_postfix(loss=...)
nodes.description: Wrap an epoch's dataloader in tqdm(...) and call set_postfix to surface live loss/accuracy/examples-seen next to the bar.

nodes.title: self.training branch
nodes.description: Code path diverges on self.training flag; dropout and batchnorm behave differently in train vs eval.

nodes.title: pre_training_setup + training_step + evaluate + train
nodes.description: Factor a training run into a class with these four lifecycle methods, so subclasses can override one piece at a time (e.g. add wandb, add DDP).

nodes.title: inherit + super().pre_training_setup()
nodes.description: Extend a parent trainer by subclassing and calling super() on lifecycle methods, instead of rewriting the entire class.

nodes.title: fwd-loss-back-step-zero
nodes.description: Forward pass, loss, backward, optimizer.step, optimizer.zero_grad; the inner training loop.

nodes.title: Moller-Trumbore barycentric
nodes.description: Parametrize triangle as A + u(B-A) + v(C-A); solve [-D, B-A, C-A] [s,u,v]^T = O - A; inside iff s,u,v >= 0 and u+v <= 1.

nodes.title: catch RuntimeError on solve
nodes.description: Unbatched fallback for handling singular matrices: wrap linalg.solve in try/except and return a default; replaced by the mask trick once batched.

nodes.title: self.optG + self.optD, alternating
nodes.description: DCGAN has one Adam optimizer per network; each iteration calls optD.zero_grad() -> D loss -> D.step(), then optG.zero_grad() -> G loss -> G.step(). The two networks train independently in the same loop.

nodes.title: unbind along axis
nodes.description: t.unbind(dim) (or Python first-axis unpacking) splits a tensor into a tuple along one axis; used to destructure O, D = rays and s, u, v = sol.

nodes.title: a.array if isinstance(a, Tensor) else a
nodes.description: Inside wrap_forward_fn, map over args to extract underlying ndarrays (keeping non-Tensor scalars as-is) so numpy never sees a Tensor object.

nodes.title: shrink grad back to original shape
nodes.description: When a forward op broadcast x to a larger shape, its backward must sum grad_out back down to x.shape to undo the broadcast. Two-step inverse: sum prepended dims, then sum size-1 dims with keepdims=True.

nodes.title: no_grad eval pass
nodes.description: torch.no_grad() context plus accuracy accumulator; runs at epoch end without gradient tracking.

nodes.title: update_args(args, wandb.config)
nodes.description: Inside the agent's train(), read sampled hparams from wandb.config and write them onto the dataclass args before training.

nodes.title: wandb.finish()
nodes.description: Explicitly close the run so the next call to wandb.init starts cleanly (matters inside loops/sweeps).

nodes.title: wandb.init(project, name, config)
nodes.description: Open a new wandb run, passing the dataclass args as config so all hyperparameters are saved alongside the metrics.

nodes.title: wandb.log({...}, step=N)
nodes.description: Append a metric dict at the given x-axis step (we use examples_seen so different batch sizes are comparable).

nodes.title: wandb.watch(module, log_freq)
nodes.description: Register a sub-module so wandb logs its parameter and gradient histograms automatically; log_freq set per-batch-count.

nodes.title: AdamW: theta *= (1 - gamma*lambda)
nodes.description: Decoupled weight decay applied directly to the parameter, independent of the gradient-based update; AdamW's defining change vs. Adam.

nodes.title: L2-style g += lambda*theta
nodes.description: SGD/RMSprop/Adam-style weight decay: fold lambda*theta into the gradient before the momentum/variance update.

nodes.title: numpy-fn -> Tensor-fn factory
nodes.description: wrap_forward_fn(numpy_func, is_differentiable=True) returns a closure that unboxes Tensor args to arrays, calls numpy_func, boxes the result, and attaches a Recipe. The single-most-leveraged factory in part 4.

nodes.title: grad = None as zero
nodes.description: for p in self.params: p.grad = None — None is treated as zero on first access and saves memory vs. an explicit zero tensor.
